Bug_Title: Child class methods named for parent class methods should be overrides
Bug_Explanation: The methods in the Child class have the same names as methods in the Parent class, but they do not override them due to differences in method signatures, privacy, and static nature.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case invokes the showBug method, which in turn calls methods in the Child class that are supposed to override those in the Parent class but do not due to differences in signatures, static nature, and privacy. This mismatch causes the test to fail, demonstrating the described bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test executed without any errors or failures, indicating that the bug described was not triggered during the test run.
